text:
Aisha: Morning chaos — spilled coffee + lava lamp drama. Lava lamp tipped, a little wax/water got under the power strip and the whole strip tripped. Router’s amber and internet is dead. Currently on phone hotspot :scream: pic: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F12345/lavalamp.jpg
Tom: oh no. any sparks? unplug everything and let it dry. :pray:
Kai: also check the breaker in the panel? sometimes it trips but looks fine from the switch.
Aisha: no sparks, breaker didn't trip. I tried a different outlet — strip powers but router lights stuck amber. Hotspot is fine but slow.
Ben: cheap USB-C ethernet dongles saved my life once. Anker or similar. Or tether USB to phone (it often beats hotspot wifi).
Aisha: tethered via USB, thanks Ben — speeds way better. also now my lava lamp sounds like a blender :grimacing: :coffee:
Nora: are the succulents ok though? :seedling: photos or it didn’t happen.
Aisha: succulents survived, just a little soil drama. Also ran `ip a` to confirm interfaces — had to `sudo dhclient usb0` to get an IP from the phone.
Kai: mac tip: System Prefs > Network > (click the ⋯ menu) > Set Service Order and put USB tether above Wi-Fi so routes don’t flip-flop. Saves you from random packet loss.
Tom: if the router is dead, shoot the serial to IT and they’ll RMA. Ping @ops-bot to log it. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident logged — INC-2026-214. Router RMA requested for Aisha. Replacement ETA: 3-5 business days.
Aisha: ordering a USB-C dongle as backup, hotspot until RMA. 0% productivity but 100% character-building. :sweat_smile: Thanks everyone for the quick tips!
